DOIS.VAI_CRIAR: You will create {variaveis} in the next step.
DOIS.SLUG_AJUDA: The name of the tool for the agent. If empty, we build it from the name. Only letters, numbers and _.

TRES.INTRO: This is the information the agent takes from the conversation and puts in the call. Use the same name between double braces in the address or in the body, for example {exemplo}.
TRES.NENHUMA: No information. The tool will always be called the same way.
TRES.DESCRICAO: How the agent finds this out
TRES.DESCRICAO_AJUDA: The agent reads this to know what to put here and where to get it in the conversation.
TRES.DESCRICAO_EXEMPLO: The part the person is looking for, the way they said it.
TRES.PODE_FALTAR_SIM: On: the agent can call without this information. It goes empty.
TRES.PODE_FALTAR_NAO: Off: the agent always sends a value. For it to ask the person when it does not know, say so in "How the agent finds this out".

ERRO.FORMATO: Use only letters without accents, numbers and _. E.g.: search_term
ERRO.REPETIDO: There is already information with this name.

TRES.SEM_INFORMACAO_CORPO: The body uses {variavel}, but there is no information {nome}. The call will fail.

TRES.CORPO_AJUDA: What goes along with the call, in JSON.

QUATRO.NENHUM: No header. The call goes without an access key.
QUATRO.CHAVE_AJUDA: The name the system asks for the key.
QUATRO.CHAVE_AJUDA_GUARDADO: If you change this name, you will need to type the value again.
QUATRO.SEGREDO_AJUDA: On: the value is stored encrypted and is not shown again. Use it for keys and tokens.
QUATRO.VALOR_AJUDA_SEGREDO: Secrets are never shown again on this screen.
QUATRO.GUARDADO_AJUDA: Stored encrypted. For safety, it is not shown. To change it, type a new one.
QUATRO.RENOMEADO: You changed the header name. Type the value again: the stored one only works for the old name.
QUATRO.DESLIGOU: You turned off "It is a secret". Type the value again: the stored value does not come back to the screen.
QUATRO.NOTA: The value can use what the agent fills in, with {variavel}. No need for Content-Type or Accept: they go automatically.
QUATRO.SALVA_DESLIGADA: The tool is saved turned off. The agent only starts using it after you test it and turn it on.

ERRO.REDIGITAR: Type the value again to save.
ERRO.CHAVE: Use only letters without accents, numbers and hyphen. E.g.: x-api-key
